entities.name: TBDPSCl
observations: SELFIES decodes to tert-butyldiphenylsilyl chloride, a silylating reagent.

entities.name: N-Cbz-serine
observations: SELFIES decodes to N-benzyloxycarbonyl serine with a free carboxylic acid and a primary side-chain alcohol.

entities.name: Likely serine TBDPS ether
observations: TBDPSCl with imidazole is consistent with protecting the serine side-chain hydroxyl as an O-TBDPS ether; the free carboxylic acid makes site selectivity less certain.
